# Crewship

> Crewship sets up cloud hosts for coding agents with Ansible, omp, and Firstmate.

crewship.si is a walkable text world with signs linked to the repository documentation.
The harbor build reads the repository README, feature index, and changelog for its signs.
The guides below are the canonical documentation on the main branch.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/README.md): Features, quick start, and repository layout.
- [Setup](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/SETUP.md): Installation and first host setup.
- [Feature index](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/docs/features.md): Guides for core and optional features.

## Host and agents

- [Architecture](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Host components and agent supervision.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): Host settings and optional profiles.
- [omp](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/docs/omp.md): Sign-in, model roles, and agent skills.
- [Security](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/docs/security.md): Access controls and host security.
- [Migration and recovery](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/docs/recovery.md): Updates, migration, and recovery procedures.

## Project

- [Contributing](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development checks and contribution rules.
- [Harbor](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/site/README.md): The walkable world, documentation signs, build, and deployment.
